=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:801-806, 1163, 1182-1219 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The heal-scope gate (run_heal_plan_scope_gate) approves an exact out-of-scope path listed after a metadata line, because extract_plan_file_paths breaks at the metadata line and the loose scan skips plain exact paths.
  WHY: The implement-time guard still blocks the commit, so the impact is a stalled run rather than an out-of-scope merge. Severity disagreement: the sonnet and luna reviewers said NIT, while gemini and minimax said MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:805-806, 896-897, 1031-1034 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A metadata line placed before the file bullets makes extract_plan_file_paths return [], so plan_files_outside_files_touched returns [] and the plan is auto-approved.
  WHY: The plan gate fails open, while the heal gate fails closed through heal_scope_plan_paths_missing. Severity disagreement: sonnet said NIT, while gemini and minimax said MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:734 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude_sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: _PLAN_FILES_METADATA_RE allows at most three leading spaces, so a four-space-indented nested metadata item is not recognised and its backticked paths are read as planned files.
  WHY: That can trigger an unneeded plan_files_outside_files_touched hold, which is the original #5101 symptom. Severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini and luna said NIT, while minimax said MAJOR. The highest is used.
- changelog.d/consumer-5101-plan-files-scope-mode-metadata.md:4 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog claims the heal-scope checks "only ever get a shorter list", but the gate's loose scan still reads the whole section and an exact path after the metadata line is missed.
  WHY: The changelog and the code disagree, which misleads operators during incident review.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The same change has to be ported to main … or the next main → stable promotion reverts it."
  expected_change_site: The corresponding plan prompt, scope-guard, regression-test, and prompt-pin files on `main`.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]

  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The test only places metadata after the bullets, has no case with metadata before a bullet, no case with a four-space-indented nested item, and no run_heal_plan_scope_gate case with an exact out-of-scope bullet after a metadata line.
- requirement: The changelog and PR description say every caller of extract_plan_file_paths, including the heal-scope checks, only gets a shorter list and that this is safe.
  expected_change_site: run_heal_plan_scope_gate (lines 1163, 1182-1209) in scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py, or the changelog and PR claim
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk changes the heal gate or the loose scan, and the exact-path branch of the loose scan does not add the token to loose. For the plan and heal gates a shorter list means fewer paths are checked.
